integrity: Infinite counting identity proved by a first-occurrence recurrence and disjoint grammar; two independently implemented finite checks are supplementary, not a replacement for proof.
scientific_limitations: Fixed binary alphabet, individual indexed linear source words, unique shortest absent subsequences; no general-alphabet or arbitrary minimal-absence count. Historical priority of this exact refined enumeration is not independently certified; prior work fully characterizes 1-nearly universal membership and the scalar tribonacci numbers are independently known.
title: A tribonacci law for binary words with a unique shortest absent subsequence
